- [EVENT] User has been testing out a few portable water filters on recent camping trips.
- [EVENT] User went on a solo trip to Yosemite six weeks ago.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Proper maintenance and cleaning tips for portable water filters:
  1. Backflush regularly.
  2. Clean the filter element.
  3. Dry the filter.
  4. Store the filter properly.
  5. Replace the filter element as needed.
  6. Inspect O-rings and gaskets.
  7. Clean the filter housing.
  8. Descale the filter if necessary.
  9. Check for blockages.
  10. Follow manufacturer guidelines.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Best practices for using portable water filters include using a pre-filter and avoiding visibly contaminated water.
